title: CAMP GX700 Chinese official product page live recheck
publisher: CAMP / 惠州市凯斯普瑞自行车有限公司
notes: The current manufacturer page identifies GX700 as a 700C 1×12 bike and lists sizes 450/480/510 mm, a T800 frame and fork, 700C×45C fitted tires, and about 10.2 kg for a small complete bike without pedals and small accessories. Its component table lists a 26–36T FC-RX610 crank despite the 1×12 label; this does not map every row to the retained GX700 GRX 1×12 build. It supplies no numeric geometry coordinates, frame-only weight, maximum tire clearance, bottom-bracket standard, or shell dimensions in page text. Do not treat the complete-bike weight as frame weight, the fitted tire as a maximum, size options as geometry, or the crank model as a bottom-bracket standard. The page also notes batch/component and size/color weight variation.
